acceptanceCriteria: 新增 cockpit-interface crate 承担 Clap 与 interface discovery；cockpit-protocol 不再直接声明 Clap 依赖。
cockpit-protocol 继续 re-export WorkItemOutcomeQueryArgs、description/spec functions、enums/constants，现有调用方签名和序列化事实不变。
CLI/MCP and protocol interface tests pass; parser-derived facts remain identical.
change is dependency/maintenance boundary only, no runtime acceleration claim.
goal: 把 interface_description.rs 迁入新的 cockpit-interface crate；cockpit-interface 承担 Clap parser 与接口发现，cockpit-protocol 保留领域协议并 re-export 既有符号；CLI、MCP、文档与测试继续消费同一事实源。
intent: 将传输相关的 Outcome interface contract 从 cockpit-protocol 的直接 Clap 依赖中隔离到轻量共享 crate，同时保持 cockpit-protocol 对现有公开接口的兼容 re-export。
outOfScope: 不改变 CLI/MCP wire names、Outcome semantics、序列化 schema、release scripts、历史兼容行为；不复制第二套参数定义；不作性能收益声明。

scenarioCoverage.expected: cockpit-protocol has no direct Clap dependency; Clap is owned by the new interface contract crate.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect workspace and crate manifests, run protocol tests, and verify the new crate builds under the locked dependency graph.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Existing cockpit-protocol exports for Outcome query arguments, enums, constants, discovery, and Markdown rendering remain available with unchanged facts.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run cockpit-protocol interface tests and compile downstream CLI/MCP consumers through the existing cockpit-protocol paths.

scenarioCoverage.expected: CLI parser-derived defaults, enum values, names, and descriptions remain generated from one interface contract; no duplicate parameter registry is introduced.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run interface description tests and inspect the moved source and re-export boundary.

scenarioCoverage.expected: CLI and MCP Outcome wire names and response behavior remain unchanged, with no Outcome or serialization semantic changes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run affected cockpit-cli and cockpit-mcp tests, including Outcome handoff and RPC suites.

sources: Source review: cockpit-protocol interface_description.rs and current CLI/MCP consumers
User authorization: implement all recommendations through WI workflow
